'''Lorcu Malshae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Moonglow (light freighter)|''Moonglow'']]. After losing a lot of money on a deal with [[Sithless Leethe]], Malshae sought to recoup his investment by selling the location of [[Port Haven/Legends|Port Haven]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. His [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Par'tha]] hated the idea and abandoned him. Although Malshae made her promise not to tell anyone about his intentions, Malshae was subsequently killed when the ''Moonglow'' exploded over [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
